description: This file implements a stock report for batch-wise balance history in an ERP system, including functions to fetch stock ledger entries, process data, and generate report columns.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the batch-wise balance history report based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Constructs report columns dynamically based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions string based on provided filters.

methods.name: get_stock_ledger_entries
methods.description: Fetches stock ledger entries from the database according to filters.

methods.name: get_item_warehouse_batch_map
methods.description: Creates a nested map of item, warehouse, batch with stock quantities.

methods.name: get_item_details
methods.description: Retrieves item details such as name, description, and UOM from the database.
